summary: Validated all 4 new features (Editable delivery date + WhatsApp reschedule, Point coupons w/ POS apply/redeem, Modo Turno Tablet + Sound, Configuración Reporte diario mailto) plus regression on nav. All 12 requested scenarios pass end-to-end on https://lavanet-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. One minor UX bug: sonner toast action 'Avisar por WhatsApp' is initially blocked by Radix DialogOverlay because the Orden detail dialog remains open after Save.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'orden-promised-save' the success toast contains an action button 'Avisar por WhatsApp', but the still-open Radix DialogOverlay (z-50, pointer-events auto) intercepts pointer events, so the toast action button is unclickable until the user manually closes the modal (Esc). By then the toast may auto-dismiss. Recommendation: close the Dialog automatically on save (or render Sonner Toaster above Radix DialogOverlay via a higher z-index / portal ordering, or move the WhatsApp CTA inside the dialog itself).

action_items: Fix DialogOverlay intercepting the sonner toast action button after orden-promised-save (close dialog on save OR raise Toaster z-index above Radix overlay OR embed the WhatsApp CTA inside the dialog).
seed_data_creation: Generated coupon LVN-CM3BD for customer c1 (Pedro Sánchez / Carmen depending on run), checkout produced ORD-1027. Another coupon LVN-WLKZG generated on customer c2 during an earlier run. Both remain in LocalStorage (redeemed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features verified. Detailed evidence: (1) EDITABLE DELIVERY DATE — orden-promised-input pre-filled from order.promisedAt; setting a new datetime and clicking orden-promised-save persists to LocalStorage (verified by reopening & by full page reload). The toast's 'Avisar por WhatsApp' action, once dialog is closed, opens https://wa.me/51<phone>?text=... containing 'Nueva fecha' and the order number (verified via window.open capture: e.g. https://wa.me/51922334455?text=Hola%20Carmen%2C%20actualizamos%20la%20fecha%20de%20entrega%20de%20tu%20orden%20*ORD-1014*%20en%20LAVANET.%0A%0A%F0%9F%93%85%20Nueva%20fecha%3A%20*14-ago.%2C%2008%3A49%20a.%C2%A0m.*). See UI bug above regarding overlay. (2) COUPONS — All 4 preset buttons cliente-coupon-gen-{100,200,400,1000} present; gen-1000 correctly disabled when balance<1000. Clicking gen-100 created coupon code LVN-XXXXX (regex /^LVN-[A-Z0-9]+$/ verified). Points balance decreased exactly 100 (785→685). cliente-coupon-wa-<CODE> anchor href starts with https://wa.me/51 and includes the code. (3) POS — Typing coupon in pos-coupon-input + pos-coupon-apply auto-selected the coupon owner (pos-customer-points appeared), rendered a 'Cupón LVN-XXXXX' line with -S/5.00 in the totals, and pos-total dropped from S/ 10.03 to S/ 4.13 (10.03 = 8.50*1.18; after -S/5 pre-IGV → 3.50*1.18 = 4.13 ✓). Completed checkout with pos-amount-paid=500 + pos-checkout → created ORD-1027. (4) REDEEMED ONCE — Coupon row now reads 'LVN-CM3BD  S/ 5.00 · Exp. 08 nov. 2026 · Usado en ORD-1027'; the cliente-coupon-wa-<CODE> anchor is removed; re-applying the same code at POS produces the 'Cupón inválido, ya usado o expirado' toast. (5) MODO TURNO TABLET — turno-tablet-toggle changes h1 className (larger typography), persists localStorage.turno_tablet='1', and advance buttons include 'h-12' class. Toggle back restores. (6) MODO TURNO SOUND — turno-sound-toggle persists localStorage.turno_sound ('0' after first click from null). turno-advance-ORD-1012 fires without any JS/console error. (7) CONFIGURACION REPORT — tab-report, report-enabled Switch, report-email input, report-send-now all present. Clicking report-send-now (with window.open overridden) captured a mailto URL starting with 'mailto:admin@lavanet.pe?subject=%5BLAVANET%5D%20Reporte%20diario...' and decoded body contains 'Reporte diario', 'Ingresos', and 'LAVANET'. 'Vista previa del reporte de hoy' KPI card is visible on the right (Órdenes, Ingresos, Entregados, Pendientes, Por método de pago). (8) PERSISTENCE — After full page reload: report-email=admin@lavanet.pe & report-enabled=checked; the generated (used) coupon still shows Usado en ORD-1027; the rescheduled orden-promised-input still reflects new datetime. (9) REGRESSION — nav-dashboard, nav-pos, nav-ordenes, nav-turno, nav-configuracion all present and clickable. Zero console errors captured during full flow.
rca_of_the_issue: For the toast-overlay bug: Radix Dialog renders an overlay with z-index 50 and pointer-events:auto covering the viewport. Sonner's Toaster is portalled at the document root but its default z-index is not high enough to sit above Radix DialogOverlay, so any toast rendered while the dialog is still open is not interactive. Options: (a) after successful save call setOpen(false) on the dialog before firing the toast; (b) raise <Toaster /> z-index above 50 (e.g. className='!z-[100]'); (c) move the 'Avisar por WhatsApp' CTA into the dialog footer next to Save so it's always reachable regardless of toast lifecycle.
